title: Observation codes
binding: a questionnaire question's own `code`, when the question is the concept
source: Confirmed against the FHIR R4 vital signs value set, which fixes the LOINC code every ABDM consumer matches a vital sign on. Step 1 implementation 2 replaces this file with a local index built from the NRCeS release files.

2708-6.note: The FHIR R4 oxygensat profile fixes Observation.code to this code and allows a more specific coding beside it. A health centre measures by pulse oximeter, which is LOINC 59408-5, but that code alone would not match a consumer looking for a vital sign. When Observation.code carries more than one coding, 59408-5 is the second one, never the first.
